verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS e-commerce platform like Gumroad, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, cookie consent or tracking preferences. The source-available repo and the vendor list found in the code do not show a user-facing opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
